text:
This is the last year of the four-year deal Vince Dunn signed in 2023, and Seattle's extension talks are a running story; Sports Radio 93.3 KJR asked last week how close the two sides are. His play this winter is the negotiation.

So far, a mixed case. Ten points in 18 games, four on the power play, at 23:01 a night is right on his pace from last season (44 points in 81 games). But he has three points in his last ten games, and at five-on-five the Kraken have taken only 38% of the shot attempts with him on the ice. Some of that is the team around him: Evolving-Hockey had his teammates in the bottom 4% by impact last season, which drags his raw numbers down.

The strengths are specific. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him getting 2.2 scoring chances per 60 from the slot last season, 96th percentile among defensemen, and carrying the puck in on 41% of his entries. The weak spot is breakouts: only 31% of his exits kept possession.

He scored against the Rangers on Nov. 7 on six shots. With Seattle's losses piling up, the Kraken need more nights like it.
